## Purpose
Turns any knowledge source into markdown with page markers (`<!-- page N -->`). It uses Mistral OCR for PDFs, images and Office files, with local parsers as a fallback, fetches URLs, and decodes text formats as they are.

## Responsibilities
- **File type sets:**
  - `TEXT_TYPES`: .txt, .md, .markdown, .json, .yaml, .yml, .csv, .tsv, .html, .htm, .xml;
  - `OCR_TYPES`: .pdf, the image types, .docx, .pptx, .doc and .ppt;
  - `IMAGE_TYPES`.
- `ExtractionError(ValueError)`.
- **Helpers:**
  - `_decode` tries utf-8-sig, then utf-16, then cp1252, then utf-8 with replacement;
  - `_html_text` uses BeautifulSoup and removes script, style, nav, footer, header and noscript;
  - `_pages_markdown(response)` joins the OCR pages with page markers, 1-based;
  - `_ocr(client, document)` calls `client.ocr.process(model=KNOWLEDGE_OCR_MODEL, document, table_format="markdown")` in a thread;
  - `_local_pdf` uses pypdf;
  - `_local_docx` uses python-docx: headings become `#`, and tables become pipe rows.
- **`from_bytes(client, data, filename, content_type)`** returns `(markdown, method)`:
  - **text types:** HTML gives "html", pretty-printed JSON gives "json", anything else gives "text";
  - **unsupported types** raise "Unsupported file type 'x'.";
  - **OCR types:** sent as a base64 data URL, either as `image_url` or as `document_url` with `document_name`. The method is "mistral_ocr";
  - **fallback:** pypdf or python-docx. Otherwise it raises "Could not read 'name': error".
- **`from_url(client, url)`** returns `(markdown, method, title)`:
  - only http and https URLs are accepted;
  - a `.pdf` URL is tried with OCR by URL first;
  - otherwise it fetches with `httpx.AsyncClient(follow_redirects, timeout=30, User-Agent "Mozilla/5.0 (knowledge ingestion)")`;
  - a PDF content type goes to `from_bytes`. Otherwise it returns HTML text, method "web", and the page title.

## Key elements
`from_bytes`, `from_url`, `ExtractionError`.

## Control flow
As above.

## Data, state and side effects
Mistral OCR calls and outbound HTTP.

## Configuration
`KNOWLEDGE_OCR_MODEL` (default `mistral-ocr-latest`).

## Interactions
- **Used by:** `ingest.add_source`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- OCR failures fall back to the local parsers.
- Images and PPTX files have no local fallback.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Page markers survive into distillation,** so every item can cite its page.
- **`from_url` fetches any http(s) URL the user supplies** and has no SSRF guard. Fine for an admin feature, but note it.
